DECLARE @HRA_CONCEPTS TABLE (HRA_ID VARCHAR(40),CONCEPT_ID VARCHAR(40))
DECLARE @JOINSTRING VARCHAR(6000)= ''
DECLARE @HRA_ID VARCHAR(40)
DECLARE @CONCEPT_ID VARCHAR(40)

INSERT INTO @HRA_CONCEPTS (HRA_ID,CONCEPT_ID)
SELECT DISTINCT HRA_ID,CONCEPT_ID
FROM PDS_OB_HRA_Codes
WHERE HRA_ID IS NOT NULL AND CONCEPT_ID IS NOT NULL

WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @HRA_CONCEPTS)
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @HRA_ID = HRA_ID,@CONCEPT_ID = CONCEPT_ID FROM @HRA_CONCEPTS

	IF @JOINSTRING <> ''
		SET @JOINSTRING = @JOINSTRING + ' OR '

	SET @JOINSTRING = @JOINSTRING + '(PMH.HRA_ID = ' + CHAR(39) + @HRA_ID + CHAR(39) + ' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = ' + CHAR(39) + @CONCEPT_ID + CHAR(39) + ')'

	DELETE FROM @HRA_CONCEPTS WHERE HRA_ID = @HRA_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = @CONCEPT_ID
END

SELECT @JOINSTRING

'SELECT	
convert(varchar(30),MC.Subscriber_ID + '00') as 'Member_Number', 
		PMH.GUID AS 'HRA_GUID', 
		PMH.HRA_ID as 'AssessmentID', 
		PMH.STATUS, 
		PMH.user_name as 'UserName',	
		PMH.EVENT_DATE	
		, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(CV_IHS_SCORE.STR_VALUE)=1 THEN CV_IHS_SCORE.STR_VALUE ELSE 0 END AS 'CV_IHS_SCORE'
		, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(CV_PREGNANCY.STR_VALUE)=1 THEN CV_PREGNANCY.STR_VALUE ELSE '0' END AS 'CV_PREGNANCY'
		
FROM	P_MEMBER_HRA PMH WITH (NOLOCK)		
		LEFT OUTER JOIN P_MEMBER_CONCEPT_VALUE CV_IHS_SCORE WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON PMH.CID = CV_IHS_SCORE.CID
			AND PMH.HRA_ID = '1889'
			AND PMH.STATUS = '2'
			AND CV_IHS_SCORE.CONCEPT_ID = '520049'
			AND ABS(DATEDIFF(HH,PMH.SYSTEM_DATE, CV_IHS_SCORE.SYS_DATE)) < 6
			
		LEFT OUTER JOIN P_MEMBER_CONCEPT_VALUE CV_PREGNANCY WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON PMH.CID = CV_PREGNANCY.CID
			AND PMH.STATUS = '2'
			AND (
					(PMH.HRA_ID = '1889' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '520043') OR (PMH.HRA_ID = '1890' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '520825') OR (PMH.HRA_ID = '1956' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '535474') OR (PMH.HRA_ID = '1959' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '535689') OR (PMH.HRA_ID = '2007' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '542405') OR (PMH.HRA_ID = '2105' AND CV_PREGNANCY.CONCEPT_ID = '561846')
				)
			AND ABS(DATEDIFF(HH,PMH.SYSTEM_DATE, CV_PREGNANCY.SYS_DATE)) < 6
			
		INNER JOIN MEMBER M WITH (NOLOCK) ON  PMH.CID = M.CID
		INNER JOIN MEMBER_COVERAGE MC WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.CID = MC.CID
		
WHERE		PMH.SYSTEM_DATE > '2011-12-15 00:00:00''
